settings.title: Settings

data.experimental_schedule_writes: Experimental multi-slot, append and delete writes

settings.description: Choose how often to poll the diffuser. Each poll briefly occupies a Bluetooth connection. Experimental schedule writes default to off and have not been validated on hardware; they are required for append, delete, or editing a list with multiple slots. Forecasts assume the recurring weekly schedule continues. Notifications default off and never stop the diffuser. Low-oil threshold must be greater than the depleted threshold.

add_scent.title: Add scent
add_scent.description: Enter a scent name to use the approximate default of 4 mg per 5 seconds of spraying. Optionally enter both custom rate fields. Oil and device differences affect actual consumption; later eligible weighings can refine the rate.

edit_scent.title: Edit scent
edit_scent.description: Only entered fields change. Renaming preserves history. Supply both rate fields together; the default rate applies to future fills only.

delete_scent.title: Delete scent
delete_scent.description: Permanently delete this scent. Scents referenced by bottle history cannot be deleted.

add_bottle.title: Add bottle
add_bottle.description: Choose 30, 60 or 120 (default 60), or enter a custom amount. Presets approximate the labeled bottle size as grams of oil, not measured mass. Custom oil amount or measured gross weight overrides the preset. Gross weight requires a known empty bottle weight. Weighing improves accuracy.

data.name: Name
data.gross_g: Measured bottle plus oil weight (g, optional)

edit_bottle.title: Edit bottle
edit_bottle.description: Only entered fields change. Leave unknown empty weight blank; zero means a measured zero tare. Set the actual empty bottle weight before recording gross weight, then use Weigh bottle to refresh the oil balance. Renaming preserves history.

install_bottle.title: Install bottle
install_bottle.description: Turn scenting off and physically install this bottle. A fresh power-off report is required. Stored balances are preserved.

store_bottle.title: Store active bottle
store_bottle.description: Turn scenting off before removing the active bottle. A fresh power-off report is required.

record_weight.title: Weigh bottle
record_weight.description: Record current gross weight using the saved empty bottle weight. If it is unknown, enter it under Edit bottle first. A fresh weighing anchors remaining oil; two eligible weighings can refine the estimated consumption rate.

correct_weight.title: Correct a measurement
correct_weight.description: Enter the corrected current gross weight and a reason. The previous measurement is retained; past usage is not rewritten.

refill_bottle.title: Refill or change scent
refill_bottle.description: Store the bottle first. Choose 30, 60 or 120 (default 60), or enter a custom amount. Presets approximate the labeled bottle size as grams of oil, not measured mass. Custom oil amount or measured gross weight overrides the preset. Gross weight requires a known empty bottle weight. Weighing improves accuracy.

data.gross_g: Measured bottle plus oil weight (g, optional)

archive_bottle.title: Archive or restore bottle
archive_bottle.description: Archive a stored bottle or clear Archived to restore it. The active bottle cannot be archived.

delete_bottle.title: Permanently delete bottle
delete_bottle.description: Permanently delete the selected bottle and all its fill and weighing history. This cannot be undone. The active bottle cannot be deleted.

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge refill alert
acknowledge.description: Acknowledge the current refill alert. This does not refill the bottle or stop scenting.

error.threshold_order: Low-oil threshold must be greater than the depleted threshold.
error.invalid_input: Check the selected item and entered values.
error.one_weight: Enter either gross weight or oil mass, not both.

abort.not_loaded: This integration is not loaded. Load it before managing inventory.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Edit an existing slot or append at the next position. Appending requires every field and experimental writes enabled. Multi-slot writes are hardware-unvalidated.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded AromaTech Ambience config entry ID.

start.name: Start
start.description: Local start time in HH:MM format.

end.name: End
end.description: Local end time in HH:MM format, later than start.

days_mask.name: Days mask
days_mask.description: Weekday bits 0–127; Sunday bit 0 remains inferred. Enable separately.

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule
delete_schedule.description: Delete a slot and shift later slots down. Requires experimental writes; hardware-unvalidated.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded AromaTech Ambience config entry ID.

record_bottle_weight.name: Record bottle weight
record_bottle_weight.description: Legacy alpha checkpoint before inventory is first installed. After that, use Manage bottle inventory with Record weight.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Loaded AromaTech Ambience config entry ID.

gross_g.name: Bottle plus oil
gross_g.description: Gross weight in grams, positive and no more than 10000.

empty_g.name: Empty bottle
empty_g.description: Empty-bottle weight in grams, from zero to gross weight.

manage_inventory.name: Manage bottle inventory
manage_inventory.description: Create, name, edit, install, store, weigh, refill or archive bottles and scents. Install/store require scenting off. Metadata changes do not control the diffuser.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: The loaded diffuser whose bottle inventory to manage.

action.name: Operation
action.description: Use the native integration options forms for guided management, or select an operation here.

scent_id.name: Scent ID
scent_id.description: Stable ID returned by List inventory.

bottle_id.name: Bottle ID
bottle_id.description: Stable ID returned by List inventory.

name.name: Display name
name.description: Renaming preserves the stable ID, usage and history.

reason.name: Correction reason
reason.description: Required for correcting a measurement; previous measurements remain in history.

empty_g.name: Empty bottle weight
empty_g.description: Optional on new bottles; omitted means unknown, not zero. Required before gross weighing. Editing tare requires a fresh weighing.

gross_g.name: Gross bottle weight
gross_g.description: Grams including bottle and oil; use the same cap/components each time.

oil_g.name: Oil weight
oil_g.description: Oil amount in grams, measured or approximate. For add/refill, omitted oil and gross weight defaults to an approximate 60 g. Supply this or gross weight, not both.

grams_per_spray.name: Grams per reference spray
grams_per_spray.description: Custom provisional consumption in grams; supply reference duration too. New scents with both rate fields omitted use 0.004 g per 5 seconds. Existing rates are preserved when editing without rate fields.

spray_seconds.name: Reference spray duration
spray_seconds.description: Seconds actively spraying in the reference measurement.

archived.name: Archived
archived.description: Archive or restore a stored bottle while retaining its history.

confirm.name: Confirm permanent deletion
confirm.description: Required for delete operations. Bottle deletion removes its fill history permanently.

list_inventory.name: List bottle inventory
list_inventory.description: Return bottle, scent and fill history plus current estimate; no device command.

acknowledge_refill.name: Acknowledge refill alert
acknowledge_refill.description: Dismiss and acknowledge the current refill status until recovery or a changed status.
